assets_external_source_id_uidx.name: assets_external_source_id_uidx
assets_external_source_id_uidx.where: "assets"."external_source" is not null and "assets"."external_id" is not null

assets_dimensions_check.name: assets_dimensions_check
assets_dimensions_check.value: ("assets"."width" is null or "assets"."width" > 0) and ("assets"."height" is null or "assets"."height" > 0)

opening_hour_exceptions_first_period_che.name: opening_hour_exceptions_first_period_check
opening_hour_exceptions_first_period_che.value: "opening_hour_exceptions"."is_closed" or ("opening_hour_exceptions"."first_opens_at" is not null and "opening_hour_exceptions"."first_closes_at" is not null)

opening_hour_exceptions_second_period_ch.name: opening_hour_exceptions_second_period_check
opening_hour_exceptions_second_period_ch.value: ("opening_hour_exceptions"."second_opens_at" is null and "opening_hour_exceptions"."second_closes_at" is null) or ("opening_hour_exceptions"."second_opens_at" is not null and "opening_hour_exceptions"."second_closes_at" is not null)

opening_hour_exceptions_closed_periods_c.name: opening_hour_exceptions_closed_periods_check
opening_hour_exceptions_closed_periods_c.value: not "opening_hour_exceptions"."is_closed" or ("opening_hour_exceptions"."first_opens_at" is null and "opening_hour_exceptions"."first_closes_at" is null and "opening_hour_exceptions"."second_opens_at" is null and "opening_hour_exceptions"."second_closes_at" is null)

opening_hours_first_period_check.name: opening_hours_first_period_check
opening_hours_first_period_check.value: "opening_hours"."is_closed" or ("opening_hours"."first_opens_at" is not null and "opening_hours"."first_closes_at" is not null)

opening_hours_second_period_check.name: opening_hours_second_period_check
opening_hours_second_period_check.value: ("opening_hours"."second_opens_at" is null and "opening_hours"."second_closes_at" is null) or ("opening_hours"."second_opens_at" is not null and "opening_hours"."second_closes_at" is not null)
